name: Aldaris
description: Latvia's largest industrial brewery, founded in 1865 and now owned by the Carlsberg Group, in the historic Sarkandaugava district of Riga. The site also houses the Aldaris Beer Museum.

name: Bauskas alus
address: Bērzkalnu iela 77, Bauska, Bauskas novads, LV-3901
description: Regional brewery in Bauska founded in 1981, with local brewing traditions stretching back to the 16th century. Produces traditional Latvian lagers, dark beers, ciders and lemonades.

name: Cēsu Alus
address: Aldaru laukums 1, Cēsis, Cēsu novads, LV-4101
description: Brewing on Aldaru laukums (Brewers' Square) in Cēsis dates to 1590, making it one of the oldest breweries in the Baltics. Now owned by the Finnish Olvi Group and one of Latvia's largest beer producers.

name: Labietis
description: Craft brewery and taproom opened in 2013 on the grounds of Riga's historic von Stricka brewery, famous for experimental pagan-inspired ales brewed with herbs, spices and native Latvian botanicals.

name: Nurme alus darītava
description: Artisan craft brewery founded in 2016 in a historic 1900 industrial building in Riga's Avotu street neighbourhood, using locally sourced northern ingredients, with an adjoining taproom and terrace.

name: Jūrmalas alus
description: Small craft brewery founded in 2019 in the coastal resort city of Jūrmala, producing lagers and ales. Exact production address not publicly confirmed.

name: Užavas alus
description: Family-run coastal brewery founded in 1994, prized for unfiltered, unpasteurised amber beer brewed from deep artesian spring water and only four natural ingredients.

name: Ventspils alus darītava Courlander
description: Craft brewery established in 2016 in the Old Town of Ventspils to revive local beer-making traditions, brewing unfiltered, unpasteurised lagers and dark beers to the 1516 German Purity Law.

name: Brenguļu alus darītava
address: "Abula", Brenguļi, Brenguļu pagasts, Valmieras novads, LV-4245
description: A family-run traditional brewery in a former hydroelectric power plant on the Abuls river, producing natural unfiltered and unpasteurised light and dark beers from local Latvian malt and hops.

name: Malduguns alus darītava
address: Parka iela 2A, Rauna, Raunas pagasts, Smiltenes novads, LV-4131
description: One of Latvia's first craft microbreweries, founded in 2013 in the historic town of Rauna, producing well-matured ales, IPAs and seasonal beers.

name: Piebalgas alus
address: Gaujas iela 2, Jaunpiebalga, Cēsu novads, LV-4125
description: A traditional brewery founded in 1989 in Jaunpiebalga, brewing unfiltered beers in open fermentation tanks with proprietary yeast strains kept for over three decades.

name: Valmiermuižas alus
address: Dzirnavu iela 2, Valmiermuiža, Valmieras pagasts, Valmieras novads, LV-4219
description: A brewery at the historic Valmiermuiža estate with roots tracing to 1764, brewing unpasteurised craft ales and running a popular brewery tour, tavern and beer school.

name: Cesvaines alus darītava
address: Rūpnīcas iela 1, Cesvaine, Madonas novads, LV-4871
description: One of the smallest craft breweries in the Baltics, founded in 2016 near Cesvaine Palace, brewing naturally carbonated beers over alder-wood fire and maturing them at least 30 days.

name: Madonas alus
description: A historic brewery operating at its ancestral Bodnieki estate since 1916, producing traditional light, dark and honey beers while preserving time-honoured methods.

name: Odzienas muižas alus
address: "Zemgaļi", Odziena, Vietalvas pagasts, Aizkraukles novads, LV-5109
description: A craft brewery founded in 2014 in the restored mill-bakery of the neo-Gothic Odziena Manor, producing an American IPA and an amber ale named 1905, alongside a rural guest house.

name: Tālavas ķēniņa alus
description: A small farm brewery established in 2014 in Lizuma parish, Gulbene region, producing unpasteurised, unfiltered, naturally carbonated craft beers fermenting in open 800-litre vats.

name: IndieJānis
address: "Kalti", Upespils, Suntažu pagasts, Ogres novads, LV-5060
description: An independent one-man craft brewery and gastrobar opened in 2017 in an 1810 barn from Kastrānes Manor, offering guided tours, tastings and wood-fired pizza on-site.

name: Agrofirma Tērvete (Tērvetes alus)
address: "Tišas", Kroņauce, Tērvetes pagasts, Dobeles novads, LV-3730
description: A large integrated farm in Zemgale brewing the widely distributed Tērvetes alus since 1971, using barley grown on its own fields to make unpasteurised, preservative-free beer.

name: Hopalaa
address: Industriālais parks, Vītoliņi, Valgundes pagasts, Jelgavas novads, LV-3017
description: Launched in 2018 in the Vītoliņi industrial park near Jelgava, Hopalaa brews unfiltered, unpasteurised beers from hop-forward IPAs to fruity sours and stouts, with an on-site taproom.

name: Hypnos Brewery
address: Industriālais parks, Vītoliņi, Valgundes pagasts, Jelgavas novads, LV-3017
description: A craft brewery that began as a small garage operation in 2018 in the Vītoliņi industrial park, known for inventive tropical sours, IPAs and spiced wheat ales.

name: Rēzeknis Bryuvers
description: Founded in 2004 in the Rēzekne Special Economic Zone, blending modern brewing with Latgalian heritage to produce beers and kvass that have become a symbol of the region.

name: VIEDI alus darītava
description: A small craft brewery established in 2015 in Jelgava, offering guided tours and tastings, with beers developed through careful recipe experimentation.

name: Zoltners alus darītava
address: "Zoltners", Kroņauce, Tērvetes pagasts, Dobeles novads, LV-3730
description: A countryside destination near Tērvete combining a craft brewery, restaurant and guesthouse, producing its own house beers with rural Zemgale hospitality.

name: Līvu alus darītava
description: A large regional lager brewery built in 2000 in Liepāja and later owned by Cido Grupa. Beer production permanently ceased in June 2020 and the facility was sold.

name: Lodiņa alus darītava
description: Founded in 1873 by Theodor Lohding in Bauska, dormant from 1958 and revived in 2007. Brews traditional unfiltered Light, Strong and Ancestral ales on copper equipment in the restored 19th-century brewery.

name: Ķimeļa alus darītava
description: Founded in 1815 in Riga by P. R. Kymmel and once one of Latvia's largest breweries. Production relocated to Ādaži as Kimmel Rīga and ceased entirely in 2007; the historic block is now the Kimmel Kvartāls cultural venue.

name: Kolnasāta
address: Stacijas iela 4, Bērzpils, Bērzpils pagasts, Balvu novads, LV-4576
description: A traditional Latgale farmhouse brewery near Lake Lubāns using wood-fired wooden vats and homegrown barley to make authentic homebrewed Latgalian beer, welcoming visitors by booking from May to October.

name: Abavas vīna darītava
description: Latvia's largest winery and cidery, making fruit and berry wines, ciders and spirits from Latvian-grown fruit, plus grape wines from its own northern vineyard near Sabile. Welcomes visitors for tastings and tours.

name: Sabiles Sidrs
address: Rīgas iela 22, Sabile, Talsu novads, LV-3294
description: A family-owned cidery in Sabile crafting traditional ciders from natural apple juice using English and French methods, with tours and tastings at the on-site Sabile Cider House.

name: Tālavas Sidrs
description: Founded in 2013 in a family garage in Gulbene, crafting 100% natural apple ciders from local Latvian produce and now one of the leading natural-beverage producers in the Baltics.

name: Jaunmoku Dārzi
address: Jaunmokas, Tumes pagasts, Tukuma novads, LV-3139
description: A family cidery beside historic Jaunmoku Castle near Tukums, producing premium cider entirely from its own Latvian-grown apples using the traditional méthode champenoise.

name: Mr. Plūme sidra darītava
description: Founded in 2010 after the owners studied at leading cider houses in France and Austria, this artisanal cidery near Lielvārde grows special apple varieties and cider pears for award-winning ciders and perry.

name: Sidra darītava Abuls
description: An artisanal farm cidery at the source of the Abuls river in Northern Vidzeme, handcrafting ciders from traditional and wild North Latvian apple varieties since 2000, with a modern facility built in 2018.

name: Ezera Sidrs
description: A small family cidery in Kurzeme making craft cider from hundred-year-old apple trees on a historic family estate near Lake Zvirgzdu; its flagship Ezera Brut launched in 2018.

name: Mūrbūdu sidra darītava
description: A craft cidery near the Ērģeme castle ruins in northern Latvia, producing 'abnormal' ciders from local apples using unconventional techniques including oak bourbon-barrel ageing, 10 km from the Estonian border.

name: Malnavas muiža (Malnovys Uobuļu Sidrs)
address: Kļavu iela 11, Malnava, Malnavas pagasts, Ludzas novads, LV-5750
description: A historic distillery at Malnava Manor in Latgale making traditional Latgalian apple cider in dry and semi-sweet styles, alongside apple brandy and šmakovka, from the manor's orchard.

name: Turkalnes muižas alus un sidra darītava
description: A manor brewery and cidery established in 2018 in a restored barn at Turkalne Manor, about 40 km east of Riga, producing apple, apple-rhubarb and mulled cider from its own 1-hectare orchard.

name: Herbsts
address: Miera iela 3, Gramzda, Gramzdas pagasts, Dienvidkurzemes novads, LV-3486
description: An independent family cidery in southern Kurzeme making natural, sulfite-free wild-yeast cider from a 60-year-old orchard and foraged wild apple trees; medalled at the Nordic Cider Competition in 2023.

name: Zilver dzērienu darītava
address: "Pīlādži", Kalnabeites, Siguldas pagasts, Siguldas novads, LV-2150
description: A family beverage estate near Sigulda growing around 80 apple varieties and producing quince and wild-apple ciders alongside fruit and berry wines; commercial production began in 2009.

name: Līgatnes vīna darītava
address: Spriņģu iela 3, Līgatne, Cēsu novads, LV-4108
description: A family winery founded in 2010 in a Līgatne sandstone cave, specialising in fruit and berry wines, wild teas and cider; named Latvia's best winery in 2018.

name: Kabiles muižas vīna darītava
address: Kabiles pils, Kabiles pagasts, Kuldīgas novads, LV-3314
description: A craft winery established in 2016 in the 18th-century vaulted cellars of Kabile Manor, producing handcrafted sparkling wines and ciders from local Kurzeme fruits and berries.

name: Vīna darītava Lauskis
address: Krapes muiža, Lēdmanes pagasts, Ogres novads, LV-5011
description: A winery and cidery founded in 2019 in the 300-year-old vaulted cellars of Krape Manor, named after pomologist Vilis Lauskis, making award-winning apple ciders and fruit wines from century-old orchards.

name: Naukšēnu vīna darītava
description: A family winery established in 2012 by the Rūja river in northern Latvia, producing certified organic fruit wines and ciders from its own 6-hectare biologically certified orchard.

name: Aizputes vīna darītava
address: Skolas iela 1, Aizpute, Dienvidkurzemes novads, LV-3456
description: A winery in the vaulted cellars of Aizpute Manor in western Latvia, producing fruit and berry wines from local ingredients with guided tastings.

name: Cremon vīna darītava
address: Krimuldas muiža, Mednieku iela 3, Sigulda, Siguldas novads, LV-2150
description: A small craft winery in a converted barn at Krimulda Manor in the Gauja National Park, making flower and berry wines, liqueurs, calvados and gin; its lilac wine won the public vote at Latvia's 2017 wine competition.

name: Durbes Veltes
description: Founded in 2010 in Latvia's smallest town, producing fruit and berry wines alongside jams and preserves using classical methods, continuing local winemaking traditions from the late 19th century.

name: Kužums Winery
address: Robežu iela 5, Mūsa, Ceraukstes pagasts, Bauskas novads, LV-3901
description: A grape winery near Bauska in Zemgale whose family has cultivated over 300 grape varieties since the 1970s, producing dry wines from locally grown grapes with autumn tastings.

name: Tērvetes vīni
address: "Krāces", Zelmeņi, Tērvetes pagasts, Dobeles novads, LV-3730
description: A family winery established in 2009 in the heart of Zemgale, producing fruit and berry wines from locally grown produce at its homestead in Tērvete parish.

name: Konkordijas alus darītava
description: A family-run business founded on a love of beer and a commitment to creating high-quality products that give beer lovers an unforgettable taste experience.

name: Ārpus Brewing Co.
address: "Jauntrenči", Eimuri, Ādažu pagasts, Ādažu novads, LV-2164
description: Independent craft microbrewery near Rīga founded in 2017, operating from its own 20hL facility in Eimuri since 2019, and known for hop-forward ales, fruity sour beers, and bold imperial stouts.

name: Iļģuciema Alus / ILGEZEEM
description: Rīga's oldest surviving brewery, tracing its roots to 1863 in the Iļģuciems suburb, today an independent modern operation producing traditional unfiltered barley beer, kvass, and natural craft beverages.

name: Alus Brālis
address: "Ojāri", Griķi, Inčukalna pagasts, Siguldas novads, LV-2136
description: Independent brewery established in 2002 in the rural Inčukalna pagasts forests, producing a range of filtered and unfiltered Latvian lagers sold through on-site stores and the neighbouring Pie Brāļa pub.

name: Latgales Alus
description: One of Latvia's oldest breweries with roots dating to 1860, producing unpasteurised barley beer in Daugavpils from its historic Dzirnavu iela facility, with guided tours and tastings available on site.

name: DUNA Brewery
address: Kaļķu iela 14, Kuldīga, Kuldīgas novads, LV-3301
description: Independent craft brewery and taproom in Kuldīga's old town, combining traditional skills with modern ales, bold IPAs, and barrel-aged beers matured in Burgundy oak casks sourced from local ingredients.

name: V1 Brewery
address: Lejupes iela 7, Ādaži, Ādažu novads, LV-2164
description: Modern craft brewery opened in 2018 in the Ādaži industrial zone, producing a diverse range of styles from Belgian classics to American-inspired ales, with brewery excursions available for visitors.

name: Jaunpils alus
address: Šķūnis Baltais Centrā, Jaunpils, Jaunpils pagasts, Tukuma novads, LV-3145
description: Family-run craft brewery launched in May 2017 in the historic village of Jaunpils, offering tours of its converted barn brewery, a taproom with snacks, and a range of ales, lagers, IPAs and wheat beers to taste and buy.

name: Saldalus
description: One of Latvia's smallest breweries, hand-crafting five traditional beer styles in Saldus since 2012 using oak-barrel fermentation, a multi-infusion mash and only natural ingredients - malt, hops, yeast and local groundwater.

name: Rose Brewery
address: Pirmā iela 38A, Ādaži, Ādažu novads, LV-2164
description: Independent craft brewery in Ādaži trading as Ādažu Meistara Alus, producing six distinctive beers sold on-site and supplied to cafés and restaurants across Latvia, with guided group tastings available by arrangement.

name: Kussh Brewery
address: Zinātnes iela 11, Sigulda, Siguldas novads, LV-2150
description: Independent craft brewery and weekday taproom in Sigulda's Peltes district, founded in 2019, known for creative hop-forward ales and rotating seasonal brews, with advance-booked brewery masterclasses for groups of 4–40.

name: HAT Brewery
address: "Lāmiņas", Katlakalns, Ķekavas pagasts, Ķekavas novads, LV-2111
description: Craft micro-brewery established in 2021 at the Lāmiņas homestead in Katlakalns, Ķekavas novads, celebrated for juicy hazy IPAs and striking Viking-themed labels; a compact taproom is also open at Dzirnavu iela 66 in Rīga.

name: Puta Brewery
description: Liepāja's first craft micro-brewery, born in 2019 inside the historic Spīķeris granary at Vecā ostmala 53, producing IPA and lager poured on tap at the adjoining Spīķeris 53 restaurant and distributed in cans across Latvia.

name: BURSH
description: One of Latvia's smallest breweries, established on 7 April 2014 in a century-old stone farmstead on the banks of the Aiviekste River in Aizkraukles novads, hand-crafting light, dark and IPA beers with local water and natural ingredients.

name: Brūzis Manufaktūra
description: Award-winning craft brewpub that opened in summer 2022 inside the renovated Manufaktūra courtyard complex in Jugla, with visible on-site brewing, seasonal ales, brunches, and concerts in a light-flooded industrial space.

name: Alus Rūme Trofeja
description: Latvia's smallest brewery, running a ten-tank nano-brewhouse in the Avotu neighbourhood, where master brewer Valdis Novikovs crafts rotating seasonal ales, dry meads and hop-forward IPAs alongside artisanal pizza.

name: Ziemeļu Enkurs
description: Craft brewpub opened in 2018 by brewer Dāvis Linde and sailor Klāvs Killo at Matīsa iela 8, producing IPAs, pale ales and Baltic-inspired styles; now permanently closed.

name: Alus darbnīca TEIKA
description: Independent neighbourhood brewery and workshop-bar in Rīga's leafy Teika district, founded in 2015, serving experimental small-batch craft ales brewed on-site in a relaxed, community-focused setting.

name: Alķīmiķis
description: Craft brewpub on Rīga's craft-beer street, housed in a charming historic wooden building, where over 15 rotating seasonal styles from rhubarb IPAs to coffee stouts were brewed and poured on-site. Now permanently closed.

name: Peter's Brewhouse
description: Old Town Rīga's only in-house restaurant brewery, steps from St. Peter's Church, brewing light, dark and red lagers on the premises and serving them alongside traditional Latvian and German cuisine.

name: Stargorod Rīga
description: Czech-style brewpub established in 2005 in a 300-year-old building at Republic Square, brewing traditional Czech lager, dark beer and special Latvian-recipe ales on classic European equipment with guided brewery tours.

name: Vecais Taizel's
description: Beloved Liepāja beer pub and brewery in the historic city centre, crafting its own fresh pilsner and seasonal ales on-site in a basement brewhouse, paired with hearty traditional Latvian dishes.

name: Aizputes muižas alus darītava
address: Liepājas iela 8A, Aizpute, Dienvidkurzemes novads, LV-3456
description: Manor brewery on the Tebra riverbank in Aizpute, producing light, dark, wheat, and pilsner beers alongside original kvass and rowanberry cider since 2018.

name: Fišera alus darītava
address: Brīvības iela 33, Viesīte, Jēkabpils novads, LV-5237
description: New craft brewery opened in Viesīte in May 2025 with a €400,000 investment, offering three lager varieties on-site alongside a bar, café, and guest house at the adjacent Biržu iela 4 visitor centre.

name: Raiskuma labumu darītava
address: Ozolu 3, Raiskums, Raiskuma pagasts, Cēsu novads, LV-4146
description: Farmhouse brewery and bakery trading as Raiskumietis, housed in a former manor barn near Cēsis, producing traditional light, dark, and cherry ales alongside wood-oven bread and alder-smoked meats.

name: Dziru Kalve
address: Liepu iela 3, Vecumnieki, Vecumnieku pagasts, Bauskas novads, LV-3933
description: Nano-brewery founded in 2021 in Vecumnieki by two craft-beer enthusiasts, producing small-batch IPAs, stouts, sours, and other hop-forward styles.

name: Windau Wines
description: A family winery and cidery in the heart of Ventspils Market, crafting wines, ciders, and sparkling wines from locally gathered berries, birch sap, and wild Latvian ingredients since 2016.

name: Vini Curlandia
description: Mārtiņš Vāgners revives a centuries-old Renda winemaking tradition at this Kurzeme vineyard, cultivating 16 Vitis vinifera varieties at one of northern Europe's most diverse grape gardens, with tastings and holiday accommodation.

name: Pienjāņi
description: Latvia's only certified organic cider producer, tending the country's largest apple orchard-nearly 40 hectares in Skaistkalnes pagasts-and selling artisan apple ciders under the Jēpis brand since 2021.

name: Kaimiņmuiža
description: A family winery established in 2017 in Kandava parish, growing six grape varieties across 2.5 hectares; tastings are offered at the nearby Kandava Wine House, and the 2021 Valiant wine earned Baltic Cup recognition.

name: Lubānas vīnotava
address: Parka iela 6, Lubāna, Madonas novads, LV-4830
description: Winemaker Oskars Žvagins produces red, white, and sparkling wines from Latvian apples, rhubarb, and quince at this small family winery near Lubāna Manor, open for tastings and tours by advance arrangement.

name: Kugrēnu vīna darītava
address: Liepu iela 16, Uzvara, Gailīšu pagasts, Bauskas novads, LV-3931
description: A small Zemgale winery in the former collective farm village of Uzvara, 12 km from Bauska, producing 16 varieties of naturally fermented fruit and berry wines from organically sourced Latvian ingredients.

name: Smilškalnu Vīns (ZS Smilškalni)
address: Tehnikas iela 12, Kuldīga, Kuldīgas novads, LV-3301
description: Berry wine producer in Kuldīga operating since 2011; makes fruit and berry wines from their own Kurmāle farm's raspberries, currants, sea buckthorn and aronia, offering group tastings by appointment.

name: Mazburkas (SIA)
description: Family vineyard in Smārdes pagasts growing about 60 grape varieties on south-facing slopes; produces award-winning white, rosé and dry red wines, with agritourism visits and tastings from May to November.

name: Mazsālijas
description: Certified organic estate near Kuldīga on the border of three parishes producing fruit, berry and grape wines from home-grown produce; also a guest house with countryside retreats and tastings.

name: Tēviņkalna vīna darītava
description: Craft winery in Zemītes pagasts offering over 20 sulfite-free fruit and berry wines, a traditional-method sparkling raspberry wine and apple brandy aged in Latvian oak, founded 2014.

name: Spilves vīna darītava
description: Forest wellness retreat in Jēkabpils novads with its own vineyard producing wine and brandies; guests enjoy vineyard walks, wine tastings, a black sauna and Ayurvedic massage.

name: Ziemeļu vīns (SIA)
address: Jaunā iela 15, Smiltene, Smiltenes novads, LV-4729
description: Small licensed producer in Smiltene city centre fermenting fruit and berry wines from locally sourced Vidzeme ingredients, established 2013; one of Latvia's northernmost winery addresses.

name: Vējkalnietis
address: "Mierkalni", Lauciene, Laucienes pagasts, Talsu novads, LV-3285
description: Laucienes pagasts winery producing over 20 varieties of fruit, berry and grape wines plus distillates and liqueurs from exclusively local ingredients using double distillation, operating since 2010.

name: MAA.studija
description: Small family winery at the Mednieki homestead in south Kurzeme's Kalvenes pagasts, growing 700 grapevines and producing sparkling and dry red grape wines alongside rural accommodation.

name: Rožleju vīna darītava
address: Rožlejas 71, Pleikšņi, Ozolaines pagasts, Rēzeknes novads, LV-4601
description: A family winery in Rēzeknes novads hand-crafting fruit and berry wines from local seasonal produce, with guided tours, tastings, and event hosting at the Rožlejas farm estate.

name: Dzimtas vīns
address: "Dzimta", Nagļi, Nagļu pagasts, Rēzeknes novads, LV-4631
description: Farm winery near Lake Lubāns run by gardener-winemaker Marta Igaune, producing fruit and berry wines and pear-apple ciders from her home orchard, with sales on-site the third Thursday of each month.

name: Vīna ceļš
address: Vīndaru iela 12, Ikšķile, Ogres novads, LV-5052
description: Ikšķile-based boutique winery by Normunds Labrencis producing sulphite-free Latvian berry and rhubarb wines under the motto 'less is more', with intimate tastings at the Libertu wine cellar by advance booking.

name: Berga Vīns
description: A small family winery 10 km from Valmiera producing award-winning Latvian fruit and berry wines, ciders, and sparkling wines, with tastings and production tours available for groups of 4–20 people.

name: Cīrulīši
address: "Cīrulīši", Kaltene, Rojas pagasts, Talsu novads, LV-3264
description: A Kaltene coastal homestead run by Gunta Rožkalne producing homemade berry and fruit wines and ciders alongside traditional smoked and marinated fish products, with advance-booking tastings near the Kurzeme shore.

name: Jokas
description: A small winery at Jokas homestead in Limbažu pagasts where Latvian-British winemaker Džons Brauns crafts some 30 varieties of berry, fruit, and botanical wines from local wild and cultivated plants, licensed for retail since 2010.

name: Lemsel
address: Vēja iela 18, Limbaži, Limbažu novads, LV-4001
description: A home berry wine producer in Limbaži crafting fruit wines named after Lemsel, the city's historic name, alongside apple-and-currant distillates and currant infusions, listed among the region's noted local producers.

name: Vidusgrūbas
description: Small farm winery in Vidrižu parish run by Daina Jankova since 2018; produces semi-sweet and semi-dry wines from home-grown currants, cherries, and raspberries alongside foraged lingonberries, cranberries, and dandelion flowers.

name: Dūmiņu vīna darītava
description: Award-winning urban winery in Bauska founded in 2012 by food technologist Ieva Dūmiņa; intimate cellar tastings present over 33 wines from local fruits and flowers, including rose petal, dandelion, and oak-leaf varieties - 2019 National Taste winner.

name: Kauča strauts
description: Rural Zemgale winery at the Visnoļi homestead in Īslīces parish near Bauska, also known as Kaucis Creek Winery; operated by Ģirts Miķelsons, producing fruit and grape wines with vineyard visits by arrangement.

name: Dobeskalni
description: Scenic winery beside the ancient Mežakalns hillfort in Vītiņu parish, Dobele region; produces over 15 fruit and berry wine varieties from home-grown and wild-harvested produce, with year-round group tastings by prior booking.

name: Ābelītes
description: Family farm winery in Zaļenieku parish specialising in apple-based wines with seasonal berry additions including lingonberry, black currant, red currant, and raspberry; EU-funded production equipment supports quality output.

name: Drubazas
description: Kurzeme family farm winery on the Abava River managed by the Dzērve family since 2011; produces around 1,000 litres annually from 10 Latvian grape varieties and seasonal fruits - including Latvia's first pumpkin wine.

name: Mājas vīna darītava "Dzidris"
description: Multi-generational family winery at the 1910-built Ozoliņi farmstead in Aiviekstes parish; licensed since 2005, brothers Oskars and Viktors craft apple, rhubarb, and currant wines and cider through a two-year natural production cycle.

name: Kaspari
address: "Tumes pasts", Tume, Tumes pagasts, Tukuma novads, LV-3139
description: Kurzeme fruit farm and apiary near Tume village producing over 22 fruit and berry wine varieties using eco-friendly methods; gooseberry, raspberry, and cherry dessert wines are local favourites, with tastings available by arrangement.

name: Rankas Vīns
description: Vidzeme forest berry winery in Rankas parish producing about 20 naturally fermented wines aged at least 36 months without additives, alongside the Meža Ogu Sidrs forest berry cider, all crafted from hand-picked wild Latvian berries.

name: Elku
address: Centra aleja 20, Lubezere, Ārlavas pag., Talsu novads, LV-3330
description: Award-winning berry and fruit wine producer in Kurzeme, offering tastings of carefully crafted wines, liqueurs, and spirits made from locally grown strawberries and quince.

name: Alus darīšanas apvienība Prusaks
description: Craft nano-brewery in a small courtyard in Majori, central Jūrmala, brewing since 2022. Alongside balanced lagers, ales and IPAs it makes experimental brews like tomato-chili gose, plus mead and seltzers, with artist-designed labels and brewery tours with tastings.

name: Mazjūras Brūzis
address: Jūras iela 73, Engure, Engures pagasts, Tukuma novads, LV-3113
description: The first and only brewery in the seaside fishing village of Engure, opened in 2023. Brews Angern Lager and Angern Dark Lager - named after the Livonian word for eels and the historic name of Engure - plus a warm spiced 'hot beer', with a taproom serving wine and local delicacies.

name: Rīgas alus darītava Vārpa
description: Historic brewery founded in 1865 in Riga's Maskavas forštate district. Declared insolvent in 2004 and liquidated; the abandoned buildings on Latgales (formerly Maskavas) iela later suffered fires and remain derelict.

name: Liepājas alus
description: The old city brewery of Liepāja with roots in the 19th century. Beer production stopped in the late 1990s, leaving Lejaskurzeme without a brewery until Līvu alus opened in 2000, and the successor company on the site went bankrupt in mid 2007. The brand lives on and is now brewed in Lithuania.

name: Lāčplēša alus darītava
address: Raiņa iela 48, Lielvārde, Ogres novads, LV-5070
description: Brewery of the legendary kolhozs Lāčplēsis in Lielvārde, where beer was first brewed for Līgo in 1948. Royal Unibrew moved production to Liepāja in 2008 and the Lielvārde plant closed. The brand lives on and is now brewed in Lithuania.

name: Gulbenes alus darītava
address: Dzirnavu iela 1, Gulbene, Gulbenes novads, LV-4401
description: Brewing in Gulbene dates to 1882, with the interwar enterprise known as the Vecgulbenes brewery. The brewery ran out of working capital during the financial crisis, stopped production in 2009 and was later liquidated.
